literalGroups.primaryGround: Tetris About L50-L52 and Corporate Bios L31-L39 directly support the 1984 creator claim and Pajitnov. Meier/Civilization (Firaxis L89-L93), Miyamoto/Mario (Nintendo L54-L58), and Iwatani/Pac-Man (Japan Media Arts Festival L42-L48) are individually supported as game creators. Frozen index 1 is scope metadata, not evidence.
literalGroups.locator: Tetris About L50-L52; Corporate Bios L31-L39; Firaxis L89-L93; Nintendo Mario history L54-L58; JMA Festival L42-L48.

literalGroups.literal: Tetris создал Алексей Пажитнов в 1984 году. В 1980-е он работал программистом Московской академии наук. Название игры соединяет греческое слово «тетра» («четыре») и любимый вид спорта Пажитнова — теннис.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Tetris About L50-L52 states Pajitnov and 1984 and explains tetra/tennis; Corporate Bios L38-L39 corroborates his creation and Moscow Academy programmer work.
literalGroups.locator: Tetris About L50-L52; Corporate Bios L38-L39.

literalGroups.literal: Сид Мейер — сооснователь Firaxis и создатель серии Civilization.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Firaxis identifies Meier as co-founder and creator of Civilization, a concrete option-specific fact.

literalGroups.literal: В 1980-е Пажитнов работал программистом Московской академии наук.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Tetris Company biography says Pajitnov worked as a programmer for Moscow Academy of Sciences in the 1980s; this adds a useful fact about the correct option beyond prompt/key.

literalGroups.literal: Миямото создал Марио: в Donkey Kong (1981) героя сначала звали Jumpman.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Nintendo says Miyamoto created Mario and that Mario was first called Jumpman in Donkey Kong (1981); both facts concern this option.

literalGroups.literal: Иватани создал Pac-Man в 1980 году и работал над более чем 50 играми.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Japanese arts agency identifies Iwatani as Pac-Man creator and says he produced over 50 games; the note teaches concrete facts about this option.
